name: Iridescent Pearl
description: Pearl white with violet and teal accents. Light only.

provenance.attribution: Keyur Golani, for the keyurgolani.name portfolio platform.
provenance.derivation: anchor-v1 from the reviewed prototype's iridescent-pearl anchors, with the light accent #8c72d9 to #8a70d6, 2% toward text and secondary #4caeb3 to #438d95, 24% toward text, so the signature fill reaches 3:1 on every surface.

fallbacks: Every display mode renders the light set, high contrast renders the set high-contrast-v1 derives from it, and print renders the light set.
caveats: Light only: it keeps its native light mode, so dark isn't offered with it.
